description: This file defines the Swing UI component for the Hono Commander Sampler in a JMeter plugin. It provides configuration UI for connecting to a Hono server, setting command parameters, and handling different trigger types.

classes.name: HonoCommanderSamplerUI
classes.description: Swing UI class for configuring the Hono Commander sampler within JMeter.

methods.name: HonoCommanderSamplerUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI components for the sampler configuration.

methods.name: getStaticLabel
methods.description: Returns the static label name for this UI component.

methods.name: createTestElement
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HonoCommanderSampler test element.

methods.name: modifyTestElement
methods.description: Populates the given test element with settings from the UI.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the UI components based on the provided test element.

methods.name: clearGui
methods.description: Resets all UI components to their default state.

methods.name: getTriggerTypePanel
methods.description: Creates and returns a panel for selecting and explaining trigger types.

methods.name: setDescriptionTextAreaDesign
methods.description: Styles the description text area for readability.

methods.name: getDescriptionTextForSelectedTrigger
methods.description: Provides an explanatory text based on the selected trigger type.
